v_property.name: property_cid
v_property.meaning: The property record's CID; the key v_roofing_permit.property_cid joins on
v_property.source: property.cid (the from_cid of every property_has_* edge; the export extra `property_cid` is the Seed root, not this)

v_property.name: property_structure_built_year
v_property.meaning: Year the main structure was built

v_property.name: coordinate_source
v_property.source: derived: geometry → gis_centroid, or address_point when geometry.source_http_request is the City of Austin address-point layer (ADR 0004), permit address → permit_point (address not in export), else none

v_property.name: roof_date
v_property.source: latest accepted terminal date (completion_date or permit_close_date, ≤ as_of, ≥ issue date) of a closed Roofing permit via property_has_property_improvement (Replacement, else New); else structure.roof_date via property_has_structure (TCAD built year only)

v_property.name: roof_age_years
v_property.meaning: Roof age in whole years; 0 allowed
v_property.source: derived: whole years from roof_date to as_of (never structure.roof_age_years)

v_property.name: last_ownership_transfer_date
v_property.source: latest dated sales_history.ownership_transfer_date (TCAD sale or transfer deed) via property_has_sales_history

v_property.name: tenure_years
v_property.source: derived: whole years from last_ownership_transfer_date to as_of

v_property.name: tenure_basis
v_property.source: derived: deed_date when the latest transfer is a TCAD transfer deed, sale_date when it is a TCAD sale, else unknown

v_property.name: owner_kind
v_property.source: derived from person_has_property / company_has_property (the current owners of the property): company when any company, else person, else unknown

v_property.name: owner_name
v_property.meaning: Owner display name; reason owner_unparsed, owner_confidential, no_owner_record or needs_review
v_property.source: person.first_name + last_name (by last, first name), then company.name (by name), each once, '; '-separated, read through person_has_property / company_has_property (ERR-28; independent of any sale)

v_property.name: owner_area_class
v_property.source: derived: the current owners' mailing ZIP (address.postal_code via person_has_mailing_address / company_has_mailing_address) against the travis-places area lists; most local class among co-owners; unknown with reason no_mailing_address, zip_not_zcta, out_of_scope (no area list in the run) or not_in_export (the export emits no address.postal_code, ADR-0002, true of Run 2)

v_property.name: owner_is_out_of_area
v_property.source: derived: true for regional/out_of_area, false for in_county, null for unknown

v_property.name: area_list_sha256
v_property.meaning: Digest of the ZIP and regional lists

v_property.name: source_url
v_property.meaning: URL of the request that fetched the record's source page
v_property.source: source_http_request: url + its multiValueQueryString (URL-encoded); else the data group's manifest sources[].url (no missing entry for the fallback)

v_property.name: captured_at
v_property.meaning: When that source was captured (source-level, not per record)
v_property.source: manifest sources[].captured_at of the source whose url the record's request uses, else of the data group's source (source-level: the latest successful receipt)

v_property.meaning: The run that produced the row

v_property.source: CIDv1 of the manifest JCS bytes
